title: Small steps: Stop first, explain second
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Use the voice safety needs, then teach, reconnect and preserve dignity.
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
practice: move to safety before giving the explanation
principle: Distinguish a necessary safety voice from shaming or prolonged anger.
nextSentence: Immediate danger must stop now. First, move to safety before giving the explanation.
keyLearning: Distinguish a necessary safety voice from shaming or prolonged anger.
